elapsed_note: wall-clock elapsed of the agent session (includes simulator waiting and download waiting); not human working time

replay.note: replayed in the matched env/init/controller; reference uses only replay-successful demos; no force labels needed

reference_acquisition.reference_extracted: per mug: median hand-minus-object offset in the object yaw frame + hand yaw relative to the executor's yaw-aligned quaternion

geometry_search.note: 864 = 16 yaws x 9 laterals x 6 heights, evaluated for both mugs per init

reuse_note: first-time onboarding cost; later tasks reuse the executor fields and the replay/reference scripts, paying only reference acquisition + runs
